state.task: Refit the Busan KTX station 3F restaurant level (식당가) in the live Unity twin. The video epoch is 2022 (upload 2022-01-01). Station frame: u = long axis (+u north), v = across (+v east / track side, -v west / plaza front). 2F floor y=7.0, current 3F floor y=12.2 (5.2 m rise, matches the generated escalator).

facts.F1_guide: 2025 blogger composite 3F guide (hi_shoobong): an L. Long row, left to right: 계단, 멘무샤, 육수당, 북창동순두부, EDIYA, 빈츠38, 비빔家; then W.C/EV at the corner; then a column top to bottom: 부산옥, EV, eggbox. Red railing runs along the inner edge of the row and of the column. '3층 에스컬레이터' is labelled at the inner corner. The bottom of the image is cut off while the column railing continues.
facts.F2_naver_3f_pins: Naver place pins tagged 3층, projected into station uv: Menmusha (32.4, 92.0), EDIYA (22.0, 91.2), Food Court (15.1, 83.9), Bibimga (-13.9, 89.0), Busanok (0.0, 65.4), Egg Box (2.6, 36.4). All six lie inside the over-track structure footprint (u -21..68, v 18..100), 25-90 m east of the main building's east wall. Their relative order matches F1: a row along u with the corner at the low-u end, then a column running toward -v.
facts.F3_naver_other_floors: Naver 2F-tagged pins fall inside the main building (e.g. B&C bakery (-72, -33), Soban (-58, -35)). The Naver 1F indoor polygons land within about 5 m of the original model's 1F section. Naver's 3F ground polygon is a generalised outline covering both the main building and the over-track structure.
facts.F4_photos_3f: A 2026 photo shows the EDIYA storefront on a 3F walkway. A glass railing beside it overlooks the high hall. Overhead are the same space-frame lattice and glass lanterns as in the video's high hall, and green departure boards hang below at 2F. Food-court seating photos (2023-2026) show large windows looking out at the Busan Harbour Bridge, port cranes and the North Port park, which lie east and south-east of the station.
facts.F5_photo_2021: 2021-06 photo taken from a 3F wing: across the high-hall void (tree columns, lattice roof) is a parallel wing with 북창동순두부 ... 빈츠38 COFFEE shopfronts, bright exterior windows behind them and LED ad screens hung under its railing. Viewer and far wing are at the same level.
facts.F6_video_2022: At 90 s the camera enters from exit 9 (east side) under a low slab ceiling whose edge is about 11-12 m ahead (registration v about 3). At 94 s, facing west: a 3F balcony with a glass railing runs along the left (south) side to the far west wall. The far west wall has a 3F balcony with red parasols. The 2F-to-3F escalator pair rises westward to that west balcony. At 112 s a LOTTERIA sign is on the west 3F wing. The video never faces east at 3F height.
facts.F7_original_model: The original model is an exterior shell with no interior partitions. At y 12.1 there is an upward slab over the east band u[-92,-48] x v[about 2.4, about 11.4]. It has an outer wall at 3F height at v=0.0631u+16.17 and an inner face at v=0.0723u+7.86. The main building's south exterior wall at 3F height is at u -90.8..-92.9. There is no other 12 m slab inside the main building. The over-track structure (선로상층부) has walls from 7.6 to 16.5 m.
facts.F8_leases: KORAIL 3F leases active by 2022: 푸드코트 787 m2 (opened 2019-01), 부산옥 86.7 m2 (2021-02). Later leases: eggbox 230.6 m2 (2023-03, contract 2022-12) and 비빔가 428.2 m2 (2024-01). A 2021 photo shows LOTTERIA on 3F.
facts.F9_current_build: The current 3F is a west wing only (u -76..-30, v -35..-25.5) plus a 2 m south strip (u -76..-74, v -27..11). It has no east wing, and its total area is about 495 m2, against at least 874 m2 leased in 2022 plus circulation.
facts.F10_window_views: Two 3F window photos (2026-05 busannavi #006 and 2026-08 freestar #003) look straight down onto a lawn park with paved paths, a wooden deck, people walking and the pylon of a cable-stayed pedestrian bridge, with port cranes and the Busan Harbour Bridge behind. No tracks or platform canopies are visible between the window and the park. The North Port park lies immediately east of the rail yard.
facts.F11_satellite: Naver satellite tiles rectified into station uv show a large separate roofed building over the tracks at u -18..68, v 12..100 (grey metal roof with vents). All six Naver 3F pins lie on it. The main building roof (u -100..70, v -50..10) has the high-hall skylight grid at u -80..-35.
facts.F12_box_shell: In the original model this over-track box (layer 선로상층부) is a shell: perimeter walls from 7.6 to 16.5 m and a roof at 21.9-26.1 m. Directly below the roof are the tracks at y 0. No intermediate floors are modelled. The live Unity scene has nothing inside it.
facts.F13_box_2f_pins: Naver 2F-tagged pins inside the box: Krispy Kreme (address text '부산역 2층 신맞이방' = new waiting hall), Somidam, Pascucci, 부산별빛샌드, Tourist Information Center, Story of lamant and Gukje Market donut. The 2025 2F blogger guide lists Krispy Kreme, Pascucci and lamant beside exit 9, plus a '3층 에스컬레이터' inside the 2F plan.
facts.F14_namuwiki: Namuwiki: the station has 3 storeys above ground with platforms at ground level. A second extension ran 2009-2010, and phase 2 was completed as an over-track station building (선상역사). Separate over-track car parks A and B are entered from 충장대로. The 3F food-court lease opened 2019-01.
facts.F15_video_path: The 2022 video walks from the platform stairs (44 s, u -92) across a sunlit glazed footbridge at u -92..-69, v 25..35 (48-76 s), enters exit 9 at u -68.8, then crosses the main-building high hall. It never enters the over-track box. The main-building 3F front mezzanine (red parasols, LOTTERIA, the 2F-to-3F escalator pair at u -71.8) is filmed.
